.octos/KNOWLEDGE-DIGEST.md: - **2026-10-01 U11 native 候选:ANativeWindow_lock/unlockAndPost 设计+补丁草稿(benchmark/2026-10-01-anativewindow-lock/)**:我们 libandroid.so 有 acquire/release/fromSurface/getWidth/getFormat/query/setBuffersGeometry/DataSpace/Transform/tryAllocateBuffers,**缺 lock/unlockAndPost**(头条 7 个 .so 引用、fd-plus Surface 软件 lock 墙同源,=NDK 软件画布路径)。照抄 AOSP14 Surface::lock/unlockAndPost:lock=dequeue→等 fence→gralloc CPU 锁得 vaddr→填 ANativeWindow_Buffer{width,height,stride(像素),format(AOSP),bits}→记 locked buf;unlockAndPost=gralloc 解锁→queueBuffer。映射到 OH:dequeue=OH_NativeWindow_NativeWindowRequestBuffer;CPU 地址=OH_NativeWindow_GetBufferHandleFromNative(ohBuf)->virAddr(OH 对 CPU-usage buf 内部已 mmap,[WESTLAKE-CPUFILL]/oh_canvas_renderer lockCanvas 同法;virAddr 空则 mmap(fd,size) 自己管);post=OH_NativeWindow_NativeWindowFlushBuffer(oh,buf,-1,Region)。**关键 stride/format 映射**:OH BufferHandle.stride 是**字节**行距、format 是 GRAPHIC_PIXEL_FMT_*;ANativeWindow_Buffer.stride 是**像素**、format 是 ANDROID_PIXEL_FORMAT_*→ format=oh_pixel_format_to_android(h->format)(surface/jni/pixel_format_mapper.h,OH 12=AOSP 1 RGBA_8888,码不同),stride_px=h->stride/android_bytes_per_pixel(fmt)(字节→像素,本桥最常见的歪图 bug 点)。实现在 framework/window/jni/oh_anativewindow_shim.cpp(AdapterAnw+OH 声明+dequeue/flush helper 都在;#include pixel_format_mapper.h),extern C 导出;与 oh_anw_wrap 关系:lock/unlockAndPost 是同一 AdapterAnw 上 10-hook 表(hwui GPU 路径)的**同侪**,走同一 OH 窗口的 dequeue/flush,只多 CPU 映射与一槽 locked-buffer 记在 AdapterAnw 上,不改 hook 表/oh_anw_wrap。需补:真 BufferHandle 结构+GetBufferHandleFromNative 声明、AdapterAnw 加 lockedOh/lockedMap/lockedSize/dirty、android_bytes_per_pixel、SET_USAGE CPU 保证 virAddr、fence poll+close、一次只一个 locked(再 lock 返 -EINVAL)。待审:OH BufferHandle 字段序需按目标镜像 buffer_handle.h 核(virAddr 偏移错则 bits 乱);部分脏区 copy-forward 暂略(全刷 OK)。证据 design.md + anativewindow-lock-draft.cpp。

- **2026-10-01 U11 发货库门(更正):ANativeWindow_lock/unlockAndPost 必须实现在 libandroid,不是 846 bridge**:oh_anativewindow_shim.cpp(AdapterAnw+oh_anw_wrap)在 bridge-sources.json/bridge15-sources.json=编进 liboh_adapter_bridge.so(846,#96 不可从源码复现,readelf 该件定义 oh_anw_wrap T),故不能在那加导出。NDK 入口 ANativeWindow_*(oh_native_window_shim.c,hwui-shim-sources)在 libandroid(可重编)且已 import 桥导出 oh_anw_get_oh(w)。**定案:新建 libandroid C++ TU framework/hwui-shim/jni/anativewindow_lock.cpp(加进 hwui-shim-sources.json+hwui15-platform-sources.json),extern C 导出**;OH 窗口走 oh_anw_get_oh(w);OH NDK OH_NativeWindow_RequestBuffer/GetBufferHandleFromNative/FlushBuffer/AbortBuffer/HandleOpt 用 dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT) 解析(常驻,不加 DT_NEEDED,保 N2 门绿);locked 状态因不能改桥的 AdapterAnw,用 libandroid 本地 std::unordered_map<OHNativeWindow*,Locked>+mutex(一窗一 locked,重 lock 返 -EINVAL)。桥字节不变=#96 不挡。采纳 3 点:① BufferHandle 字段序按 bms 冻结 sysroot buffer_handle.h,必要反汇编板上库核 virAddr 偏移;② .cpp;③ 不做 copy-forward,返回把 inOutDirtyBounds 扩成整张缓冲(NDK native_window.h 允许扩张脏区),FlushBuffer 空 region=全表面。补丁草稿 anativewindow-lock-draft.cpp 已改为 libandroid 版。定后交 cx-bms 排 U11。证据 design.md + anativewindow-lock-draft.cpp。

- **2026-10-01 U11 两待审项定死(头文件行号+偏移):① BufferHandle 字段序 ② OH CPU usage 位值**。冻结 sysroot=oh_mirror/.../graphic_surface。① buffer_handle.h:48-61(external_window.h:41 include、:559 GetBufferHandleFromNative 返 BufferHandle*):fd@0x0 width@0x4 stride@0x8 height@0xc size@0x10 format@0x14 **usage@0x18(uint64_t,非 int)** **virAddr@0x20** phyAddr@0x28 reserveFds@0x30 reserveInts@0x34 reserve@0x38。**更正初稿**:usage 是 uint64_t,format@0x14 后有 4 字节 pad,virAddr 落 +0x20(不是 +0x1c);初稿 .cpp 的 int usage 会把 virAddr 读成 +0x1c=乱指针,已改 12 字段精确结构。② native_buffer.h:67-68 CPU_READ=(1ULL<<0)/CPU_WRITE=(1ULL<<1)→usage=0x3;SET_USAGE op=5(external_window.h NativeWindowOperation 枚举 :107 SET_BUFFER_GEOMETRY=0…:137 SET_USAGE=5,入参 uint64_t)。**板上核验(诚实)**:5ea 只读拉 /system/lib64/chipset-sdk-sp/libsurface.z.so(sha 8f1879f8…,=libnative_window.so 同字节)与 ndk/libnative_window_manager.so(128680B,仅 event-filter NDK);surface/native_window 实现库是 stripped ELF(0 命名符号),离线拿不到 GetBufferHandleFromNative/getter 的反汇编**地址**(需解压/符号化=VM 重活,外环叫避开)。偏移靠两条钉死:平台与 libandroid 同编一份 buffer_handle.h;且 on-device 经验证——westlake-current 桥经 GetBufferHandleFromNative 读 h->virAddr(+0x20)成功 CPU 填+flush([WESTLAKE-CPUFILL])。符号级反汇编核验交 cx-bms 板上建库步:首次 lock 打印 handle->{stride,format,virAddr} 对头文件偏移,异常再拉 .z.so 解压反汇编。证据 design.md。
